product_overview: Mycova is a biological insecticide based on the naturally occurring entomopathogenic fungus Beauveria bassiana. The fungus infects insect pests by attaching to their outer cuticle, penetrating the body, and multiplying inside the host, ultimately causing the insect's death. Mycova provides effective control against a wide range of insect pests, including aphids, whiteflies, thrips, beetles, and caterpillars. It is valued for its target-specific action, environmental safety, and minimal impact on beneficial organisms. Due to these advantages, Mycova is widely used in Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and sustainable agricultural practices.

Infects and kills insects through cuticle penetration
Provides broad-spectrum pest control
Safe for beneficial insects (when used correctly)
Suitable for organic farming and IPM programs
Leaves no harmful residues
Helps in resistance management
Improves sustainable crop protection

mechanism_of_action.description: Beauveria bassiana conidia adhere to the insect cuticle, germinate, and penetrate through enzymatic degradation using proteases, chitinases, and lipases. The fungus colonizes the hemocoel, produces insecticidal secondary metabolites, and suppresses the pest through mycosis followed by external sporulation.

product_overview: Biota is a biological fungicide and plant growth–promoting bioagent based on the beneficial fungus Trichoderma asperellum. It works by colonizing the plant root zone and suppressing soil-borne fungal pathogens through mechanisms such as competition, mycoparasitism, and the production of antifungal metabolites. Biota helps control diseases caused by pathogens like Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, Pythium, and Sclerotium. In addition to disease suppression, it enhances root development, improves nutrient uptake, and promotes overall plant vigor. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Disease Management (IDM) programs due to its environmental safety and compatibility with organic farming practices.

Suitable for organic farming and IPM programs
Improves crop yield and survival rate

It also produces antifungal secondary metabolites and can trigger host defense priming, thereby suppressing soil-borne pathogens and improving root health.

product_overview:
Ecoviz™ harnesses Isaria fumosorosea to biologically control a broad range of damaging insect pests for sustainable crop protection.

Ecoviz™ is a biological insect-control solution containing Isaria fumosorosea, a naturally occurring entomopathogenic fungus. It infects susceptible insect pests by attaching to their outer surface, penetrating the cuticle and multiplying within the host. Ecoviz™ helps manage whiteflies, aphids, thrips, mealybugs and other soft-bodied pests, supporting healthy crops and sustainable pest-management practices.
key_product_highlights: Entomopathogenic fungus (Isaria fumosorosea) at 1 × 10¹⁰ CFU/g
Effective against whitefly, aphids, thrips, mites, and other soft-bodied pests
Colonises the insect via cuticle penetration and internal mycosis
Compatible with most biological IPM programs
Safe for beneficial insects and pollinators
Approved for organic and residue-free cultivation

mechanism_of_action.description: Isaria fumosorosea conidia adhere to the insect cuticle, germinate under favourable humidity, penetrate through the exoskeleton via mechanical pressure and enzyme activity, and multiply inside the haemocoel until the host dies of mycosis. Sporulation on the cadaver produces secondary inoculum for continued suppression.

shelf_life_statement: Best used within 12 months of manufacture. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
compatibility_statement: Compatible with most biopesticides and biostimulants. Avoid tank-mixing with chemical fungicides.
storage_safety: Store in a cool, dry place below 30 °C, away from direct sunlight and chemical fertilisers.
technical_positioning_summary: A powerful biological solution derived from nature, providing effective control of key insect pests while supporting healthier crops and sustainable agriculture.
